description: NIP-55 remembered-permission cases, run against both the Dart Nip55ApprovalPolicy (test/features/nip55/domain/nip55_permission_parity_test.dart) and the Kotlin Nip55PermissionMirror (android/app/src/test/java/io/diogel/symudol/Nip55PermissionParityTest.kt). The source of truth for matching (diogel-io/symudol#17). expected: allow, reject, or none (no remembered decision: review).

cases.note: An allow for any kind is never used: every such signature is reviewed (#5).
A remembered refusal for any kind covers every kind.
The grant's relay is normalised too.
Trusting an app to decrypt DMs covers zap receipts.
The zap's peer is not known when matching, so a grant for one peer does not cover it (#17).
Trusting an app to decrypt DMs covers zap receipts.
The zap's peer is not known when matching, so a grant for one peer does not cover it (#17).
A grant for Symudol itself would serve any caller (#11).
A grant from before certificates were recorded matches any caller.
The certificate could not be read when the grant was made, so it matches no caller (REQ-NIP55-010).
